On August 4, 2020, an exploit in Opyn's ETH put option contracts on Ethereum allowed an attacker to drain roughly $371,000 in USDC by abusing the exercise logic to double-spend oTokens in a single transaction. The protocol fully reimbursed affected put sellers and secured remaining funds via coordinated white-hat recovery. The Opyn ETH put option contract allowed the exercise function to use the same msg.value for multiple internal exercise calls within a single transaction, enabling double spending of ETH put oTokens and USDC collateral when exercising against multiple vaults simultaneously.
